# Bug Catalog: `verify/encounters.gd`

**Generated by /design-tests on 2026-09-06**
**Scope:** normal-world guardian discovery, trigger, reward, and map-to-battle enemy identity.

## What this file does

It constructs a normal World, starts a normal new game, and proves that a player can physically reach each artifact guardian. It distinguishes ordinary encounters at an artifact location from stepping into the actual guardian, which must preserve its item and selected enemy identity.

## Public interface

| Symbol | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `ItemGuardian.spots()` | content query | Returns real-world artifact position and assigned enemy. |
| `World._build_item_guardians()` | scene construction | Adds the visible decoy and trigger into a normal dive world. |
| `ItemGuardian.body_entered` | player event | Starts the actual guarded-item fight. |
| `Battle.enemies` | built encounter result | Exposes the visual actor a player encounters after the trigger. |

## IO boundaries

- Asset/scene construction: dynamically imported Angler and Swordfish actor nodes.
- Physics: world collision/approach query and Area3D trigger.
- Randomness: ordinary encounter composition; guardian battles are fixed to one enemy.

## Bug catalog

| # | Bug | Blast radius | Plausibility | Test type | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | A normal-world artifact site builds an Angler-compatible decoy for both locations, even though trench is configured as Swordfish. | High — the user cannot encounter the new model through play. | The old test only counted `Goblin`-contract decoys; both assets share that parent type. | map-to-battle integration | characterized |
| 2 | Stepping into a correctly displayed guardian starts a generic Angler battle rather than the site’s selected enemy. | High — map art and combat identity contradict one another. | World and Battle receive identity via separate code paths. | round-trip integration | characterized |

## Test plan

### Bug #1 — real-world decoy identity

- **Test type:** map-to-battle integration.
- **Description string:** `"REAL WORLD GUARDIAN: <item> decoy is <enemy> at its reachable artifact site — guards against a Swordfish that only exists in a review URL"`
- **What it catches:** both physical sites using the Angler default despite content assignment.
- **Self-critique:** observes a normal constructed World and actor public identity, not private implementation details.

### Bug #2 — trigger identity drift

- **Test type:** round-trip integration.
- **Description string:** `"REAL WORLD GUARDIAN: <item> trigger builds <enemy> battle — guards against map/battle identity drift"`
- **What it catches:** enemy identity omitted between a normal Area3D trigger and Battle construction.
- **Self-critique:** it can pass under any refactor that preserves the actual player route; checking the constructed battle is stronger than a screenshot.

## Skipped

- Manual pathfinding input from spawn to each site — collision-free straight approach and the player-equivalent trigger are already exercised; a fixed WASD recording would be brittle to harmless camera/speed changes.
- Exact render colors — the Swordfish’s untextured white material is artist-approved, so identity and visibility are the stable observable contracts.

## Post-write evaluation

- **Bugs caught:** none. The correct map-to-battle wiring already existed before this strengthened acceptance check.
- **Bugs characterized:** #1 and #2. The previous count-only assertion would accept two Anglers because both actors deliberately share the `Goblin` gameplay contract; this test now rejects that mutation at the actual map sites and after the player-equivalent trigger.
- **Bugs discovered during writing:** the first run used a 3 m proximity limit while the intentional guardian offset is 3.22 m. The limit is now 4 m: close enough to identify the placed guardian without falsely rejecting the collision-safe placement.
